questions.question: You document a component of your software architecture. Which information should be contained in the black box description and which should be avoided? One item belongs in neither — leave it unsorted.

items.text: The commit history of the file.

questions.explanation: Dummy explanation text. The commit history is a distractor that belongs in neither category.

questions.question: You need to gain global administrator privileges to the Azure AD tenant that contains the self-signed users. Which four actions should you perform, in sequence?

answers.text: Sign in to the Microsoft 365 admin center.
Create a self-signed user account in the Azure AD tenant.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, add the domain name.
Respond to the Become the admin message.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, remove the domain name.
Create a TXT record in the contoso.com DNS zone.

questions.explanation: Dummy explanation text. The two unused options are distractors that are never placed.

questions.question: For each of the following statements, decide whether it is true (yes) or false (no).

answers.text: A black-box description hides the internal structure.
A black-box description must list every private field.
Interfaces belong in a black-box description.

questions.explanation: Dummy explanation text. Each statement is answered with yes or no; the question is correct only when every verdict matches.
